purpose: Determine whether the authenticated OARS confirmatory decision traces justify a signal-isolating OARS-v2 shadow implementation.
provenance_requirements: Authenticate every main archive against its terminal authentication receipt.
Authenticate each raw ledger against the receipt's declared artifact SHA-256.
Reconstruct every choice set from controller-ordered lifecycle events.
Require exact agreement with recorded baseline, proposal, candidate count, selected identities, opportunity sums, and token sums.

policies.recorded_fifo: The recorded four-group baseline at each decision.
policies.age_only_band: Within 0.98-1.02 times FIFO tokens, maximize total learner-version lag, then total ready age, then lower tokens.
policies.m4_total_band: Within the same two-sided token band, maximize total registered L1 opportunity, then lower tokens.
policies.m4_risk_band: Within the same two-sided token band, maximize imminent-expiry registered L1, then total registered L1, then lower tokens.
policies.shuffled_m4_risk_band: Apply the m4_risk_band optimizer after independently permuting the eight observed L1 values within each decision; evaluate selections using the unpermuted L1 values.

development_gate.provenance: All 20 arms and all 1280 decisions must authenticate and reconstruct exactly.
development_gate.service: Every m4_risk_band decision must select four groups with a token ratio in [0.98, 1.02] relative to recorded FIFO.
development_gate.signal_ablation: m4_risk_band must exceed mean shuffled selected true L1 in all 20 arms and by at least 10 percent after aggregation.
development_gate.staleness_comparator: m4_risk_band must exceed age_only_band selected L1 in at least 16 of 20 arms and by at least 5 percent after aggregation.
development_gate.metric_robustness: m4_risk_band must exceed age_only_band selected L2 in at least 16 of 20 arms.

interpretation_boundary: This is a retrospective one-step policy-development analysis on policy-generated choice sets.
It cannot estimate a counterfactual queue trajectory, training-quality effect, wall-time effect, or causal mediation through M4.
A passing gate authorizes only local OARS-v2 design, implementation, tests, and shadow qualification planning; it does not authorize training or EOS submission.
